blurb: Guests can enjoy the nation's largest floating obstacle course, a Ninja Course, Hamster Wheels, a Zipline, and the Zoom Floom slide. The park offers cable wakeboarding with equipment rental, a floating pickleball court, and birthday party packages. Activities are suitable for various ages with some restrictions and require online booking.
extraNote: Full refund minus $15 cancellation fee if cancelled at least 48 hours before activity · No refunds for cancellations made less than 7 days before booked activity · Park open rain or shine; may close temporarily for lightning or wind warnings · No outside food or drink allowed; no alcohol except purchased inside and consumed in designated areas · No smoking or tobacco products allowed in the park · Lockers available for rent for $15 online or $20 onsite with $5 deposit refunded on return · No tailgating allowed in parking lot; parking is free with limited in and out privileges · All activities must be booked online prior to arrival, no exceptions · Wakeboarding mid April to end of October…
